prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare co-purchase patterns across store locations and seasonal periods to reveal location- and season-specific buying behavior.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
),
order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        oi1.order_id,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2
    FROM retail.order_items oi1
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
    JOIN filtered_orders fo
      ON fo.order_id = oi1.order_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        product_id_1,
        product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY product_id_1, product_id_2
),
total_orders AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
    FROM retail.orders
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
)
SELECT
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    pc.co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(pc.co_purchase_frequency::numeric / NULLIF(to2.total_order_count, 0), 6) AS order_share,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.co_purchase_frequency DESC, p1.product_name, p2.product_name) AS bundle_rank
FROM pair_counts pc
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = pc.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = pc.product_id_2
CROSS JOIN total_orders to2
ORDER BY bundle_rank
LIMIT 20;
SELECT store_id, store_name, is_online FROM retail.stores ORDER BY store_id;

WITH store_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.store_id, s.store_name
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name IN (
        'Zava Retail Seattle',
        'Zava Retail Bellevue',
        'Zava Retail Tacoma',
        'Zava Retail Spokane',
        'Zava Retail Everett',
        'Zava Retail Redmond',
        'Zava Retail Kirkland',
        'Zava Retail Online'
    )
), store_order_counts AS (
    SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS total_orders
    FROM store_orders
    GROUP BY store_id
), pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        so.store_id,
        so.store_name,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT so.order_id) AS store_level_co_purchase_frequency
    FROM store_orders so
    JOIN retail.order_items oi1 ON oi1.order_id = so.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id = so.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
    GROUP BY so.store_id, so.store_name, oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pc.*,
        ROUND(pc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency::numeric / soc.total_orders, 6) AS store_level_order_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.store_name ORDER BY pc.store_level_co_purchase_frequency DESC, pc.product_id_1, pc.product_id_2) AS rn
    FROM pair_counts pc
    JOIN store_order_counts soc ON soc.store_id = pc.store_id
)
SELECT
    r.store_name,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2,
    r.store_level_co_purchase_frequency,
    r.store_level_order_share
FROM ranked r
JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = r.product_id_1
JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = r.product_id_2
WHERE r.rn <= 10
ORDER BY r.store_name, r.store_level_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2;

WITH order_season AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
            ELSE 'Fall'
        END AS season
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
)
SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
FROM order_season
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season;

WITH order_season AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12, 1, 2) THEN 'Winter'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring'
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer'
            ELSE 'Fall'
        END AS season
    FROM retail.orders o
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
),
season_totals AS (
    SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM order_season
    GROUP BY season
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT
        os.season,
        oi1.product_id AS product_id_1,
        oi2.product_id AS product_id_2,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi1.order_id) AS co_purchase_frequency
    FROM order_season os
    JOIN retail.order_items oi1
      ON oi1.order_id = os.order_id
    JOIN retail.order_items oi2
      ON oi2.order_id = os.order_id
     AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
    GROUP BY os.season, oi1.product_id, oi2.product_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        p.season,
        p.product_id_1,
        pr1.product_name AS product_name_1,
        p.product_id_2,
        pr2.product_name AS product_name_2,
        p.co_purchase_frequency,
        ROUND(p.co_purchase_frequency::numeric / st.total_orders, 6) AS season_level_order_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.season ORDER BY p.co_purchase_frequency DESC, p.product_id_1, p.product_id_2) AS bundle_rank
    FROM pairs p
    JOIN season_totals st ON st.season = p.season
    JOIN retail.products pr1 ON pr1.product_id = p.product_id_1
    JOIN retail.products pr2 ON pr2.product_id = p.product_id_2
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE bundle_rank <= 10
ORDER BY season, bundle_rank, product_id_1, product_id_2;

WITH order_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    s.store_name,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (12,1,2) THEN 'Winter'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (3,4,5) THEN 'Spring'
      WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) IN (6,7,8) THEN 'Summer'
      ELSE 'Fall'
    END AS season
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
), pair_orders AS (
  SELECT
    ob.store_name,
    ob.season,
    oi1.order_id,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_1,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_2
  FROM order_base ob
  JOIN retail.order_items oi1 ON oi1.order_id = ob.order_id
  JOIN retail.order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id = ob.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p1 ON p1.product_id = oi1.product_id
  JOIN retail.products p2 ON p2.product_id = oi2.product_id
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    store_name,
    season,
    product_name_1,
    product_name_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS store_season_co_purchase_frequency
  FROM pair_orders
  GROUP BY store_name, season, product_name_1, product_name_2
), store_season_totals AS (
  SELECT
    store_name,
    season,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM order_base
  GROUP BY store_name, season
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    pc.store_name,
    pc.season,
    pc.product_name_1,
    pc.product_name_2,
    pc.store_season_co_purchase_frequency,
    ROUND(pc.store_season_co_purchase_frequency::numeric / NULLIF(sst.total_orders, 0), 6) AS store_season_order_share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pc.store_name, pc.season
      ORDER BY pc.store_season_co_purchase_frequency DESC, pc.product_name_1, pc.product_name_2
    ) AS rn
  FROM pair_counts pc
  JOIN store_season_totals sst
    ON sst.store_name = pc.store_name AND sst.season = pc.season
)
SELECT
  store_name,
  season,
  product_name_1,
  product_name_2,
  store_season_co_purchase_frequency,
  store_season_order_share
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY store_name, season, store_season_co_purchase_frequency DESC, product_name_1, product_name_2;
